versions.changelog:
Initial release of geo-local-optimizer: an orchestrator skill for AI-powered local business GEO optimization.

- Provides a structured workflow for local business GEO optimization targeting both classical search and AI answers.
- Activates for any local business queries (shops, clinics, stores, etc.) involving local discovery, reviews, or map/listing presence.
- Outlines an 8-step workflow covering business context capture, presence audit, and entity/page strategy design.
- Coordinates with related GEO skills for technical audits, schema generation, and optimization tasks.
- Emphasizes making businesses easy for AI models to understand, cite, and recommend for local queries.
